summary: U-BX Technology Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on April 27, 2026, announcing the pricing of a $4.55 million registered direct offering. The offering consists of units priced at $0.30 per unit, each comprising one Class A ordinary share and a warrant to purchase 0.3 of a share. FT Global Capital, Inc. is the exclusive placement agent and Kingswood Capital Partners, LLC is co-placement agent. The offering is expected to close on April 29, 2026, pending customary conditions. Despite being a capital markets transaction, this is an ordinary seasoned equity offering under an effective shelf registration, not a special situation. Watch for dilution and share price impact post-closing.
